# Agent Reach

> Makes it easier for CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, ...) to reach the internet: login-walled platforms (XiaoHongShu, Twitter/X, Reddit, LinkedIn), video/audio content (YouTube and Bilibili subtitles, podcast transcripts), Chinese platforms, and clean structured data (Xueqiu, V2EX, GitHub). One entry point, one JSON output shape.

## Install

- [Installation Guide](https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/blob/main/docs/install.md): agent-executable steps
- Install from GitHub only: `uv tool install https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/archive/refs/tags/v2.0.0.zip` (or `pipx install` with the same URL), then `agent-reach setup`. The PyPI package named `agent-reach` is NOT this project.

## Commands

- `agent-reach channels`: channels, actions, params (live source of truth)
- `agent-reach <channel> <action> [args]`: e.g. `agent-reach bilibili search python`
- `agent-reach read <url>`: read a link with the matching channel
- Output: `{schema_version, ok, channel, action, backend, items, meta, error}`; error codes NEED_SETUP, NEED_LOGIN, UPSTREAM_BROKEN, TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED, NOT_FOUND, BAD_INPUT
- Management: `setup`, `add|remove <channel>`, `login|logout <channel>` (the user logs in), `browser setup|start|status`, `doctor`, `check`, `watch`, `update`, `configure`, `uninstall`

## Channels

- default: github, youtube, v2ex, web (web is a fallback when the agent's own search/fetch fails)
- optional: xiaohongshu, bilibili, reddit, linkedin, boss, xiaoyuzhou, xueqiu
- experimental: twitter, facebook, instagram
